title: VAHAN National Register / RC details
steps: Vehicle Search / Know Your Vehicle Details. Save current RC validity, owner serial, RTO, HP/financier and compliance.
limits: May require CAPTCHA/sign-in; printed RC is not live verification.

title: National Transport Repository (NTR)
steps: SERVICE → Know Vehicle/DL Details → RC search; note accident count and compliance indicators.
limits: Owner or own OTP may be required; count does not prove severity.

title: VAHAN application history
steps: Select state/RTO → Status → Know Your Application Status.
limits: Payment success is not approval. Do not start a new application for lookup.

title: National e-Challan
steps: Check Pending Challan Status → Vehicle Number → manual CAPTCHA → Get Details.
limits: A no-match does not clear separate state fines.

title: Maharashtra e-Challan
steps: Search by vehicle and chassis/engine characters.
limits: Registered owner's OTP may be required. Obtain report with consent.

title: Pollution Under Control (PUC)
steps: PUC certificate search → registration → VIN suffix → manual CAPTCHA.
limits: Paper records may require confirmation if digital record absent.

title: NCRB Digital Police Vehicle NOC
steps: Citizen Services → Generate Vehicle NOC using allowed login.
limits: Own OTP/CAPTCHA may be required; cannot verify accident-free history.

title: Mumbai Police stolen/unclaimed vehicle
limits: Page refreshing with no result is inconclusive, not cleared.

title: ZIPNET regional stolen vehicles
steps: Search actual table by registration then VIN.
limits: Participating-state records, not an all-India clearance.

title: Hyundai India recall checker
limits: Hyundai only. No recall does not prove mechanical condition.

title: Maruti Suzuki recall checker
limits: Maruti only. Do not paste an RTO application number as VIN.

title: Manufacturer service and bodyshop history
steps: Contact an authorised service facility with owner's permission to request service, mileage and repair records.
limits: Brand link is example; replace with relevant manufacturer, records are not fully public.

title: Maharashtra HSRP
steps: Navigate to official HSRP provider for the registration RTO and verify fitment before booking.
limits: Confirm fitment applicability first. Do not transact during read-only lookup.
